from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF

doc = Document("./testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")
paragraphs = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]

maya_start = None
maya_end = None
customers = ["Jordan Alvarez", "Evan Parker", "Nina Patel", "Alicia Morgan", "Sofia Ramirez"]

for i, text in enumerate(paragraphs):
    if text.strip() == "Maya Chen":
        maya_start = i
    elif maya_start is not None and text.strip() in customers:
        maya_end = i
        break

if maya_end is None:
    maya_end = len(paragraphs)

maya_lines = paragraphs[maya_start:maya_end]

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.add_page()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)

pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 18)
pdf.cell(0, 12, "Customer Activity Report", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT", align="C")
pdf.ln(4)
pdf.set_draw_color(60, 60, 60)
pdf.set_line_width(0.5)
pdf.line(10, pdf.get_y(), 200, pdf.get_y())
pdf.ln(6)

def sanitize(text):
    text = text.replace('\u2014', '--')
    text = text.replace('\u2013', '-')
    text = text.replace('\u2018', "'")
    text = text.replace('\u2019', "'")
    text = text.replace('\u201c', '"')
    text = text.replace('\u201d', '"')
    return text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

for line in maya_lines:
    stripped = sanitize(line.strip())
    if not stripped:
        continue
    if stripped == "Maya Chen":
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 14)
        pdf.cell(0, 10, stripped, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        pdf.ln(2)
    elif stripped.startswith("Email:"):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
        parts = stripped.split(" | ")
        for part in parts:
            key, _, val = part.partition(": ")
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
            pdf.cell(pdf.get_string_width(key + ": ") + 2, 7, key + ": ", new_x="END")
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
            pdf.cell(pdf.get_string_width(val) + 8, 7, val, new_x="END")
        pdf.ln(8)
    elif stripped.startswith("Order ORD-"):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
        parts = stripped.split(" | ")
        order_part = parts[0] if parts else stripped
        pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240)
        pdf.cell(0, 7, order_part, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT", fill=True)
        if len(parts) > 1:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
            detail_line = " | ".join(parts[1:])
            pdf.cell(0, 7, "    " + detail_line, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
    elif stripped.startswith("Items:"):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "I", 9)
        pdf.set_text_color(80, 80, 80)
        pdf.cell(0, 6, "      " + stripped, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        pdf.set_text_color(0, 0, 0)
        pdf.ln(3)

output_path = "./testbed/docs/maya_chen_customer_report.pdf"
pdf.output(output_path)
print("PDF saved to " + output_path)
